questions.q: Which activity is an example of platform or network hosting?
a: Listing a product for sale on eBay or Airbnb
Manufacturing a laptop or making a pizza
Consulting on a client's computer problem
Designing a new company logo
questions.why: Lesson 3 groups eBay and Airbnb listings under platform and network hosting, alongside production and problem-solving.
